questions.question: Voters in the Canadian province of Alberta took part in multiple referendums, notably addressing which major issue?
questions.explanation: Albertans cast their ballots on ten questions, one of which asked whether the province should pursue separation from Canada.
questions.context: 2026 Alberta referendums, 2026 Alberta independence referendum: Albertans vote on ten referendums, including one to decide if Alberta should seek separation from Canada.

questions.story: Andorra–European Union relations, San Marino–European Union relations, Potential enlargement of the European Union
questions.question: Which two microstates recently formalised closer diplomatic ties by signing an association agreement with the European Union?
questions.explanation: Both Andorra and San Marino agreed to new association deals with the EU.
questions.context: Andorra–European Union relations, San Marino–European Union relations, Potential enlargement of the European Union: Andorra and San Marino each sign an association agreement with the European Union.

questions.story: Cuba–United States relations > 1996 shootdown of Brothers to the Rescue aircraft, United States embargo against Cuba
questions.question: A court in the United States issued an arrest warrant for which former world leader concerning the 1996 downing of civilian planes?
questions.explanation: A Florida judge issued a no-bail warrant for former Cuban president Raúl Castro regarding charges tied to the 1996 Brothers to the Rescue shootdown.
questions.context: Cuba–United States relations > 1996 shootdown of Brothers to the Rescue aircraft, United States embargo against Cuba: A judge in Miami-Dade County, Florida, United States, issues a no-bail bond arrest warrant for former Cuban president Raúl Castro after Florida attorney general James Uthmeier charged Castro with conspiracy to commit first-degree murder by directing spies to infiltrate Brothers to the Rescue and ordering the attack on their planes in 1996.

questions.question: Rescue operations were launched following a fatal collapse at an open-pit gold mine in which country?
questions.explanation: The fatal incident occurred at an open-pit site located in the Nariño Department of Colombia.
questions.context: Six miners are killed and at least 12 others are missing when an open pit gold mine collapses in Nariño Department, Colombia.

questions.question: Which country's police detained ten individuals following assaults on European diplomats and an American photojournalist in the West Bank?
questions.explanation: Israel Police took 10 suspects into custody and gathered evidence in relation to the attacks.
questions.context: Israeli settler violence: Israel Police arrest 10 people in the occupied West Bank over attacks on American photojournalist Heidi Levine and the mayor of Aulnoye-Aymeries, France, who were travelling with European diplomats, and seize vehicles and other evidence during raids.
